baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated fronted object إِيَّاكَ governs the plural verbs نَعْبُدُ and نَسْتَعِينُ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Submissive service and requested backing form a two-part orientation: allegiance is restricted to the addressee, then the efficacy needed to continue that allegiance is restricted to the same addressee.

activation_trace.role: Submissive worship supplies the pledged act and makes the first clause an allegiance claim.
Helping and backing supply the requested support and make the second clause the enabling side of that allegiance.

changed_reading.before: We worship you and we ask you for help as two coordinated statements.
changed_reading.after: Our submission is directed only to you, and even the backing by which we sustain it is sought only from you.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: نَعْبُدُ and نَسْتَعِينُ are both active first-person plural verbs despite the dependent relations carried by their roots.
baseline_models.mechanism: Owned status removes sovereign self-possession without removing action; seeking backing then supplies caught-up strength. The result is agency exercised from dependence, not passivity.

activation_trace.role: Owned status supplies the speakers' non-sovereign position and frames their action as dependent service.
Strength that has caught up supplies operative capacity and makes aid the completion of dependent agency.

changed_reading.before: The speakers abase themselves and then request an external intervention.
changed_reading.after: The speakers accept non-sovereign status while asking for the capacity by which dependent service can genuinely act.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus verb نَعْبُدُ can activate service as magnification, while نَسْتَعِينُ explicitly keeps that service dependent.
baseline_models.mechanism: Service is not exhausted by self-lowering: it raises and honors its object. Assistance prevents this magnifying service from being construed as a self-generated achievement.

activation_trace.role: Honoring and magnifying supply the upward-facing effect of service on the one served.
Backing supplies what lets the honoring action persist without becoming a claim of self-sufficiency.

changed_reading.before: Worship is primarily the speakers' downward posture.
changed_reading.after: Worship is also active magnification of the addressee, sustained by aid the speakers do not claim to originate.

context_deltas.mechanism: Prior naming and identification resolve the repeated deictic object, while tenderness changes assistance from generic reinforcement into backing governed by the disclosed character of the one addressed.

activation_trace.role: Submissive worship remains the focus act whose object is newly specified by context.
Helping remains the requested function but acquires a relational quality from the preceding descriptors.
A name as declaration and indication supplies a disclosed identity behind the later pronoun.
The worshipped object links the named addressee directly to the focus act of service.
Tender mercy supplies the governing quality under which exclusive aid is sought.

structural_cues: The context identifies and describes the addressee before 1:5, while 1:5 repeats a fronted pronoun instead of repeating a name.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies naming, the worshipped object, and tender mercy; I infer that these antecedents control the later deictic address and color the requested backing. A live alternative is that the context identifies the addressee but the repeated pronoun marks exclusivity alone.

changed_reading.before: Exclusive worship and help are directed toward a grammatically salient but otherwise bare 'you.'
changed_reading.after: The doubled 'you' points back to an already named, worshipped, merciful addressee, so aid is requested within a disclosed relation rather than from an abstract power.

context_deltas.mechanism: The womb branch recasts dependence as life held and formed within a sustaining enclosure. This cross-pressures the owned-status baseline without erasing its asymmetry.

activation_trace.role: Owned status supplies radical dependence and the asymmetry that the enclosure image revises.
Assistance supplies ongoing support rather than a one-time command from above.
The womb supplies a containing and formative image for dependent life.

structural_cues: The mercy root is doubled in 1:1 and doubled again immediately before the ownership and service sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated mercy language and a womb branch; I map enclosure and formation onto the focus relation, making support prior to and concurrent with service. The less figurative alternative is ordinary compassion with no containing mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Dependent speakers serve an owner and then ask that owner for help.
changed_reading.after: The speakers act from within a dependence that also holds and forms them, so service emerges from sustained life rather than naked coercion.

context_deltas.mechanism: Prior praise relocates credit before the speakers announce their own verbs. The help clause then prevents 'we worship' from becoming self-congratulation.

activation_trace.role: Active worship supplies a real deed that could otherwise be heard as the speakers' achievement.
Requested backing qualifies the deed by denying that its capacity is self-originated.
Praise opposed to blame places positive valuation with the addressee before the speakers mention themselves.
Advertising one's benefaction supplies the rejected possibility of turning the plural action into self-credit.

structural_cues: Third-person praise precedes the shift to first-person plural action, and the action is immediately followed by a request for help.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies praise, a branch of claiming benefaction, active plural service, and sought backing; I infer that the sequence distinguishes responsible action from authorship of its power. Alternatively, praise and petition may be adjacent devotional acts without an agency correction.

changed_reading.before: The speakers confidently report what they do.
changed_reading.after: The speakers own the act of service while refusing to own its ultimate credit or capacity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repair, completion, growth, and nourishment turn aid into a developmental process. Service is the activity of beings continually brought toward operative form, not a task performed after formation is complete.

activation_trace.role: Devotional obedience supplies the practice into which the speakers are being formed.
Caught-up strength supplies the focus-side transition from incompletion to usable capacity.
Repair, nurture, and completion supply the formative process behind requested aid.
The non-dominant growth and nourishment mapping makes that formation organic and ongoing.

structural_cues: The title in 1:2 precedes the first-person request, and the focus sequences doing before an admission of needed capacity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nurture, completion, growth, and strength reaching maturity; I infer a causal arrow from divine formation to capable service and from continued aid to continued growth. A live alternative treats lordship as authority only and aid as episodic.

changed_reading.before: Already capable servants perform worship and request help when needed.
changed_reading.after: The servants are still being repaired, nourished, and brought into the strength by which their service becomes possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: A compact branch activates the two focus clauses as a relational pair: service is voiced as commitment, and backing is voiced as the provision without which that commitment cannot be kept.

activation_trace.role: Submissive obedience supplies the committed action on the speakers' side.
Backing supplies the requested provision that makes the commitment performable.
A compact or covenant supplies the relational form that binds pledge and petition together.

structural_cues: The same fronted object begins both coordinated clauses, giving the pair a formula-like symmetry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a compact branch, exclusive service, and requested backing; I infer that symmetry can stage commitment and provision as a covenantal pair. The live alternative is a one-sided confession and petition with no reciprocal compact.

changed_reading.before: The verse juxtaposes a declaration and a request.
changed_reading.after: The verse can be heard as a compact-shaped utterance: we commit exclusive service and seek the backing required to keep that commitment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Possession and disposal, a bounded severe event, and reckoning place present service under a future settlement. Assistance becomes what is needed for obedience to endure to that horizon.

activation_trace.role: Submissive obedience supplies the conduct exposed to later accounting.
Backing supplies the endurance needed to carry present obedience toward settlement.
Possession with power of disposal supplies the asymmetrical authority under which the speakers act.
A day as a severe event supplies a future pressure point rather than undifferentiated time.
Accounting and recompense supply the settlement toward which accountable service runs.

structural_cues: The ownership and reckoning clause immediately precedes 1:5, so the focus declaration follows an announced horizon of consequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies authority, severe bounded time, reckoning, service, and backing; I infer that anticipated settlement gives the focus verbs temporal endurance and accountability. Alternatively, 1:4 may motivate devotion without specifying what aid does.

changed_reading.before: Worship is a present act and help answers a present need.
changed_reading.after: Worship is obedience carried under answerability toward a future settlement, and help is sought for the endurance that trajectory requires.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus root's material passability branch meets explicit route, guidance, and straightness branches. Service becomes path-work: repeated practice makes a route traversable, while aid keeps the traversal directed and balanced.

activation_trace.role: Physical smoothing and subduing supply the focus-side image of making a route passable.
Assistance supplies the support that keeps path-work from depending on unaided exertion.
Gentle direction toward a route or truth supplies orientation for the focus request.
The straight road makes the material passability image explicit in the following request.
Straightness, balance, and levelness supply the desired geometry of the traversable route.

structural_cues: The general request for aid in 1:5 is immediately followed by a specific plural imperative for guidance along a road.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a passable-road branch inside the focus root and then an explicit guided straight road; I infer that service helps wear or prepare the route and aid preserves its orientation. The live alternative is that the road only specifies the next request and does not revise worship.

changed_reading.before: Worship is a stationary devotional act followed by a general request for help.
changed_reading.after: Worship is also collective route-making and traversal, with help sought to keep that practiced way passable and straight.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guidance supplies direction and upright care supplies continuous preservation. The help clause therefore concerns maintenance of a standing practice, not only rescue at moments of incapacity.

activation_trace.role: Devotional obedience supplies the practice that must be kept standing.
Backing supplies continuous support rather than merely emergency intervention.
Gentle direction supplies ongoing correction of the practice's heading.
Care, preservation, and guardianship supply the maintenance function assigned to aid.

structural_cues: The plural request continues across 1:5 and 1:6, moving from general assistance to maintained direction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies backing, gentle direction, and preserving care; I infer a continuous maintenance arrow from sought aid to sustained service. The alternative is punctiliar guidance that identifies a route once.

changed_reading.before: We ask for help when our own ability fails.
changed_reading.after: We ask to be continuously upheld and gently corrected so that exclusive service remains standing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gift and benefaction branches interrupt a transactional inference from 'we worship' to 'therefore help us.' Aid is received as favor that enables service, not wages earned by it.

activation_trace.role: Service supplies the action that could be mistaken for payment offered in exchange.
Requested backing supplies the benefit whose basis is being reclassified.
A gracious gift sent toward one loved supplies a non-wage model for guidance and help.
Benefaction and good condition supply the favorable state within which service proceeds.

structural_cues: The later request identifies the road through a prior benefaction, placing guidance inside a history of giving.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies service followed by help, then gift and benefaction images; I reverse the tempting wage arrow and treat favor as enabling service. A live alternative allows a simple petition after obedience without either wage or gift logic.

changed_reading.before: Our service may sound like the stated ground on which help is requested.
changed_reading.after: Help and guidance are unearned gifts that make service possible, not compensation generated by service.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ease, softness, and good living weaken a coercive realization of the owned-status branch. Asymmetry survives, but the context resists reading service as mere forced reduction.

activation_trace.role: Owned status supplies the asymmetrical baseline being tested.
Enslaving or reducing supplies the coercive extreme that later benefaction makes less adequate.
Softness, ease, and flourishing supply the counterpressure against naked coercion.

structural_cues: The requested route is identified through those already receiving benefaction rather than through a class defined only by compulsion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies owned and coercive branches alongside ease and benefaction; I infer that the latter qualify how the former may be rendered. The live alternative is that severe dependence and experienced ease coexist without one weakening the other.

changed_reading.before: The ownership branch can dominate the verse as unilateral subjugation.
changed_reading.after: The ownership register remains live, but service is more plausibly dependence accompanied and enabled by benefaction than forced reduction alone.

context_deltas.mechanism: Replacement, active opposition, and loss of orientation turn repeated exclusivity into a stabilizing constraint. Help is sought not just to accomplish service but to keep its object from being substituted, resisted, or lost.

activation_trace.role: Submissive obedience supplies the orientation vulnerable to redirection.
Backing supplies preservation of orientation as an additional function of aid.
Changing an image or substituting one thing for another supplies the failure mode of displaced allegiance.
Opposition and contrariness supply the failure mode in which service reverses into resistance.
Deviation from guidance and intended aim supplies the failure mode of directional drift.

structural_cues: إِيَّاكَ is fronted and repeated in 1:5; 1:7 then defines the requested route partly through exclusions and failed orientations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies substitution, opposition, and deviation after doubled exclusive address; I infer that the repetition functions as resistance to those three failures and that aid preserves allegiance. Alternatively, the repetition may intensify devotion while 1:7 independently classifies routes.

changed_reading.before: The doubled object says only that worship and help have one exclusive recipient.
changed_reading.after: The doubled object also acts as an anti-drift discipline: do not replace the object, reverse into opposition, or lose the intended aim.

context_deltas.mechanism: Community, scattering, and wandering activate the focus root's own dispersal branch. The plural 'we' is no longer presumed unified; repeating one object and seeking one backing performatively gather actors with divergent trajectories.

activation_trace.role: Scattering into different directions supplies a latent fracture within the collective service verb.
Mutual assistance and backing supply the force that can hold a plural body together.
A group or community supplies the social body implicit in the first-person plural.
Flight and the scattering of a group amplify the possibility that the speaking collective can fragment.
Wandering from the intended aim supplies divergent trajectories that require reorientation.

structural_cues: Both focus verbs and the following guidance request are plural, while the object of both focus verbs is singular and repeated.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a community, two independent scattering images, wandering, and mutual backing; I infer that common address and assistance re-cohere a plurality. The live alternative is that the plural is already unified and each dispersal branch concerns unrelated lexical domains.

changed_reading.before: A unified community simply speaks with one voice.
changed_reading.after: The utterance helps make a community: potentially scattered speakers converge on one addressee and seek the backing that keeps their paths from separating.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ع و ن to ع ي ن mapping rather than the ordinary help branch. It remains anchored in نَسْتَعِينُ through that supplied mapping and coheres with honoring service, but downstream prose should present it only as a watchful-presence activation, not as the verb's lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The exclusive request نَسْتَعِينُ is paired with service that can honor its object, allowing aid to be imagined as remaining under attentive care.

activation_trace.role: Watchful care supplies sustained protective attention as an exploratory mode of assistance.
Honoring service supplies the relational act performed under that attention.

changed_reading.before: Seeking help asks for an intervention or added force.
changed_reading.after: Seeking help may also imagine placing the serving community under an attentive, preserving gaze.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This economic model is surprising because it joins a non-dominant cash branch of the focus root to debt and possession branches in 1:4. It remains anchored in the focus pair of dependent service and sought resource, but it should be rendered as a cross-domain provision analogy, never as a claim that نَسْتَعِينُ means cash.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Owned-status service followed by a request for aid permits an analogy in which a dependent actor lacks the present resource needed under an outstanding obligation.

activation_trace.role: Owned status supplies the dependent party in the economic analogy.
Present tangible funds supply an image for immediately available capacity.
Possession and disposal supply the asymmetrical ownership frame.
Financial debt supplies the open obligation against which present provision is needed.

changed_reading.before: The speakers ask generally for divine help after declaring service.
changed_reading.after: The pair can momentarily image dependent servants asking for present provision to meet an obligation they cannot fund from themselves.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant ه د ي to ه د د mapping and the cutting-road branch. It remains connected to the focus request for backing and to the following guidance request, but downstream prose should qualify it as an obstacle-removal image rather than an etymology of guidance or a mandate for violence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: نَسْتَعِينُ can request force against impediments, while the solidity branch of نَعْبُدُ supplies endurance during passage.

activation_trace.role: Backing supplies the force requested when the route is obstructed.
Strength and solidity supply the serving community's endurance.
Severe breaking and demolition supply an exploratory image of removing what blocks guidance.
A decisive cutting edge supplies the route's capacity to pass through an obstruction.

changed_reading.before: Aid gently points the servants toward an unobstructed route.
changed_reading.after: Aid may also be imagined as breaking obstructive structures and opening passage while service supplies the durability to continue.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus help root carries a branch of renewed war, which the later cutting and retaliatory images can awaken. It remains anchored in exclusive allegiance and requested backing, but downstream prose should contain it as a conflict-pressure model and must not collapse worship into combat.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sequence 'we serve only you, and only you we ask to back us' can function as allegiance language when a conflict is recurrent rather than inaugural.

activation_trace.role: Submissive obedience supplies exclusive allegiance under pressure.
A seasoned, repeated conflict supplies the setting in which backing is sought again.
A cutting edge supplies decisiveness within the conflict-pressure image.
Intensified anger rising toward retaliation supplies the danger that makes allegiance consequential.

changed_reading.before: The verse is a peaceful confession followed by a general petition.
changed_reading.after: Under a contained conflict activation, it can sound like renewed allegiance and a request for backing amid an already recurring struggle.

strongest_changes: The explicit road context activated the focus root's material passability branch, changing worship from a stationary act into practiced path-work sustained by aid.
Replacement, opposition, and wandering turned repeated إِيَّاكَ into a discipline that resists displaced allegiance and directional drift.
Naming, mercy, nurture, and reckoning made the addressee and the temporal shape of dependence more specific without eliminating competing ownership, gift, and covenant models.
summary.what_was_special: The focus yielded several coexisting agency models rather than one gloss: exclusive allegiance, dependent but real action, honoring service, formative support, path-making, maintenance, and collective re-coherence. Split mappings also preserved a watchful-eye reading of aid and an obstacle-breaking reading of guidance as contained exploratory activations.
remaining_uncertainties: The clause order supports both service-then-aid and aid-enables-service arrows; context strengthens the latter without canceling the former.
Material branches such as smoothing, scattering, cash, and demolition are visibly packet-anchored but form-distant, so their proper downstream prominence remains uncertain.
Owned dependence, merciful enclosure, covenant, and gift may be rival social models or simultaneous aspects of the same asymmetric relation.
